newsitem.title: GERMANY: German jailed for Philippines child abuse.
newsitem.headline: German jailed for Philippines child abuse.

text.p: A German court on Wednesday jailed a man for having sex with an 11-year-old girl in the Philippines, in the latest in a number of convictions aimed at tackling the booming "sex tourism" trade.
The 32-year-old businessman, identified as Thomas Breuer, was sentenced to 3-1/2 years in prison after the court in the western town of Iserlohn found he had sex with the girl at least three times.
The girl was flown in to testify in the case, one of a handful which have resulted from a ground-breaking legal change letting suspects be tried for sex offences committed abroad.

Last month a Berlin court sent two men to jail for producing pornographic films with young boys in Thailand, and in September a German was sentenced in Frankfurt to two years in prison for having sex with a 10-year-old girl during a holiday in Thailand.
The victim in the latest case told the court how the accused tied her to a bed to have sex with her, and recorded the acts on video.
"You exploited this girl's desperation, neediness and poverty to satisfy your desires," judge Heinz-Wilhelm Vaupel told Breuer.

Breuer was originally detained in the Philippines but jumped bail of around $2,000 and fled back to Germany. A Dutchman he went on holiday with is also being investigated for child abuse by Dutch police.
German child welfare experts say about 200,000 German men travel abroad each year for sex, many seeking girls under 14.
The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) estimates there are at least one million child prostitutes in Asia alone.
